terbaru.pelajaran: This paper presents BladeChain, a blockchain-based system providing immutable traceability for blade inspections throughout the component life cycle.

terbaru.judul: ACE-GF-based Attestation Relay for PQC - Lightweight Mempool Propagation Without On-Path Proofs
terbaru.pelajaran: We present AR-ACE (ACE-GF-based Attestation Relay for PQC), in which relay nodes forward objects plus compact attestations (e.g., identity-bound signatures or commitments) and do not generate, hold, or forward any full validity proof.

terbaru.judul: ZK-ACE: Identity-Centric Zero-Knowledge Authorization for Post-Quantum Blockchain Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: We present ZK-ACE (Zero-Knowledge Authorization for Cryptographic Entities), which replaces transaction-carried signature objects with identity-bound ZK statements.

terbaru.judul: SoK: The Evolution of Maximal Extractable Value, From Miners to Cross-Chain
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a conceptual taxonomy distinguishing potential from realized extractable value, and single-domain from cross-domain phenomena.
